repo_notes.content: Jekyll pagination plugin (alpha status) for Jekyll 3.8.5+: paginate pages or collection documents, filter items by any frontmatter key including nested keys, and group index pages by frontmatter keys (e.g. per-category indexes).

Template model: a page/document with 'pagination: enabled: true' is consumed as a template — removed from output, but used to generate an index page per pagination page, each carrying a 'paginator' Liquid variable with its items.
Templates can be authored manually or auto-generated from 'pagination: templates: generate' config entries.
Fork-era lineage: successor to jekyll-paginate-v2 (itself the successor of the deprecated jekyll-paginate).
See README.md for the full config reference (items, group, filters, permalinks, sorting).
